notes: If a candidate answers a question correctly, full marks must be awarded. If a candidate gives more than one answer to a question, award marks for the first attempt only, provided it is not deleted. Consistent accuracy applies in all aspects of the marking guidelines. Next to each tick that is indicated, the mark allocation is also indicated as S (statement) or R (reason). If the statement and the reason are incorrect, then no marks are awarded. If the statement is correct but the reason is incorrect or omitted, then 1 mark is awarded for the statement. If the statement is incorrect but the reason is correct, then no marks are awarded. If the statement and the reason are correct, then 2 marks are awarded.

Construction: Draw $\mathrm{OA}$ and $\mathrm{OB}$.

In $\triangle\mathrm{ADO}$ and $\triangle\mathrm{BDO}$:

$\mathrm{OA}=\mathrm{OB}$ [radii]

$\mathrm{OD}=\mathrm{OD}$ [common side]

$\mathrm{AD}=\mathrm{DB}$ [given]

$\therefore\triangle\mathrm{ADO}\equiv\triangle\mathrm{BDO}$ [S;S;S]

$\mathrm{ADB}$ is a straight line

$\therefore\hat{D}_1=\hat{D}_2$ [$\triangle\mathrm{ADO}\equiv\triangle\mathrm{BDO}$]

$\therefore\mathrm{OD}\perp\mathrm{AB}$ [$\angle$s on a straight line]

parts.working_md:
$\hat{P}_1=\hat{Q}_1$ [tan-chord theorem]

$\hat{S}_1=\hat{Q}_1+\hat{Q}_2$ [ext $\angle$ of cyclic quad]

$\therefore\hat{S}_1=\hat{P}_1+\hat{Q}_2$

$\hat{T}_2=\hat{R}_2+\hat{Q}_2$ [ext $\angle$ of $\triangle$]

but $\hat{P}_1=\hat{R}_2$ [given]

$\hat{T}_2=\hat{P}_1+\hat{Q}_2$

$\therefore\hat{S}_1=\hat{T}_2=\hat{P}_1+\hat{Q}_2$

In $\triangle\mathrm{ASD}$ and $\triangle\mathrm{ACR}$:

$\hat{A}=\hat{A}$ [common $\angle$]

$\hat{S}_1=\hat{T}_2$ [proven]

$\hat{T}_2=\hat{C}_2$ [alt $\angle$s; $\mathrm{QS}\parallel\mathrm{CA}$]

$\therefore\hat{S}_1=\hat{C}_2$

$\hat{D}_1=\hat{R}_1$ [sum of $\angle$s in $\triangle$]

$\triangle\mathrm{ASD}\parallel\parallel\triangle\mathrm{ACR}$

$\therefore\dfrac{\mathrm{AD}}{\mathrm{AR}}=\dfrac{\mathrm{AS}}{\mathrm{AC}}$ [corresponding sides in proportion]

$\dfrac{\mathrm{AS}}{\mathrm{AC}}=\dfrac{\mathrm{SD}}{\mathrm{CR}}$ [$\triangle\mathrm{ASD}\parallel\parallel\triangle\mathrm{ACR}$]

$\therefore\mathrm{AS}=\dfrac{\mathrm{AC}\times\mathrm{SD}}{\mathrm{CR}}$

$\dfrac{\mathrm{AS}}{\mathrm{AR}}=\dfrac{\mathrm{CT}}{\mathrm{CR}}$ [line $\parallel$ one side of $\triangle$ OR proportional theorem; $\mathrm{TS}\parallel\mathrm{CA}$]

$\therefore\mathrm{AS}=\dfrac{\mathrm{AR}\times\mathrm{CT}}{\mathrm{CR}}$

$\therefore\dfrac{\mathrm{AC}\times\mathrm{SD}}{\mathrm{CR}}=\dfrac{\mathrm{AR}\times\mathrm{CT}}{\mathrm{CR}}$

$\therefore\mathrm{AC}\times\mathrm{SD}=\mathrm{AR}\times\mathrm{CT}$
